decisions.detail: QUOTE: `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member #else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member #endif` and "So `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` compiles to `ctx->private_state` by default... Library code is exempt through `common.h`... Test and tool code that is not one of those translation units gets the mangled names." | WHY: The answer shows both macro branches and explains that code defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS sees plain names while ordinary consumers see the private_-prefixed ones. || QUOTE: `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member #else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member #endif` and "So `ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` compiles to `ctx->private_state` by default. A user who writes `ctx->state` gets a compile error" and "Test and tool code that is not one of those translation units gets the mangled names." | WHY: The answer shows both macro branches and explains that code defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS (the library, via common.h) sees plain names, while ordinary consumers get the `private_` names. || QUOTE: `#ifndef MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) private_##member #else #define MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member) member #endif` and "`ctx->MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(state)` compiles to `ctx->private_state` by default" with "Test and tool code that is not one of those translation units gets the mangled names" | WHY: The answer shows both macro branches and explains that code defining the opt-out sees plain names (library, programs, or any consumer who defines it) while ordinary consumers see the `private_` renamed ones.
